title: Geology
subtitle: Mysteries in the rocks
summary: How to read rock: what layers, crystals and fossils record, and how people worked out the age of the Earth, the drift of continents, the ice ages and why the ground shakes. Each lesson starts from a puzzle in the field or in the history of science, with live figures and real maps. Branches on Seattle, Whidbey Island and the ice age floods are to come.
